verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor! Louvai a Deus no seu santuário; louvai-o no firmamento do seu poder!

verses.en: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.pt: Louvai-o pelos seus atos poderosos; louvai-o conforme a excelência da sua grandeza!

verses.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.pt: Louvai-o ao som de trombeta; louvai-o com saltério e com harpa!

verses.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.pt: Louvai-o com adufe e com danças; louvai-o com instrumentos de cordas e com flauta!

verses.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.pt: Louvai-o com címbalos sonoros; louvai-o com címbalos altissonantes!

verses.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Tudo quanto tem fôlego louve ao Senhor. Louvai ao Senhor!
